Boghicea drone fragments found; controlled disposal reported

5 November 2026 · Boghicea · Drone fragments discovered

Police-reported drone debris; origin and connection to earlier flight unresolved

A resident notified Sagna rural police after finding scattered fragments in Boghicea. Police, firefighters and SRI specialists attended. ProTV reports specialists detonated the remains on 5 November evening after examination and a RO-Alert warning.

Foreign origin, fall date and any link to N129 remain unconfirmed. ProTV provides a clear disposal-completion report; no direct official completion statement was retrieved. Eyewitness lettering does not establish operator or model.

One discovery record, not a newly verified flight or additional UAV count. Possible relationship to N129 remains unresolved; merge or cross-reference if evidence later establishes the same drone. Emergency response and disposal warning are not separate occurrences.
